name: pnp-powerplatform-snippets-brick-club-responsive-header
title: Brick Club Responsive Header
shortDescription: A responsive Power Apps navigation header with desktop buttons, a compact dropdown, and active-page highlighting.
longDescription: A responsive navigation header for Power Apps canvas apps that displays four navigation buttons at widths of 960 pixels and above and a compact dropdown below 960 pixels. Includes a shape-based brick icon, active-page highlighting, and notification placeholders for connecting your own screens. Uses native shapes and classic controls with no external images or connectors.

thumbnails.alt: Brick Club responsive header with desktop buttons and phone and tablet navigation dropdowns
